fatal_blocker: The official phase packages publish planned excavation contours, cross-sections, survey-unit boundaries and cut/fill calculations, but not two completed final measured excavation-depth polygons. The Phase 4-5 work description states that cut lines were derived from contamination contours and a TIN, that guided excavation would continue until radiological criteria were met, and that the gross cut lines could change during implementation. The final-status survey plan verifies residual radiological concentrations through sampling grids; it is not a final topographic excavation-depth or backfill-thickness survey and states no project-specific horizontal or vertical depth uncertainty. The cited May 2009 PRAR/FSSE was confirmed to exist but was not exposed in the indexed administrative-record list or recovered from the official PDF endpoint.
key_evidence: USACE identifies SLAPS as a 21.7-acre tract and reports that more than 600,000 cubic yards were removed before formal closure in May 2007.
The Phase 4-5 package includes survey-unit maps, excavation contour maps, cross-sections and excavation-depth cross-sections.
Planned surfaces were generated from point or contour data using a TIN and a 3-foot calculation grid for cut/fill volumes.

The document states that initial gross cut lines were based on historical and pre-design data and could be adjusted during remedial action as guided excavation and additional information became available.
The final-status survey plan stops excavation when radiological surveys indicate that the excavation bottom meets cleanup criteria and uses statistical sample grids to verify residual concentrations.
No final measured before-and-after excavation depth table, certified depth polygons, or numerical survey accuracy for physical depth was found.

The site includes an active rail spur, Coldwater Creek, drainage structures, berms, sedimentation or retention basins, wells and reconstructed channels, preventing conservative certification of two clean 30-40 m interiors from the available records.
The recovered work descriptions do not prove that two candidate zones received one matching final topsoil and vegetation assembly.
next_action: Continue the approved search for a completed closure or excavation report that publishes final measured depth by named polygon or cell, uses one common vegetated restoration assembly, states numerical survey uncertainty, and preserves two 30-40 m clean interiors.
